facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes, freely; banks report transfers of USD 10,000 or more.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Yes: residents may hold foreign currencies freely; USD accounts are common.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Local options like ABA PayWay and KHQR weren't researched yet.
facts.L1_registration: Register online with the Ministry of Commerce, then with the tax department.
facts.L2_tax_id: Taxpayer number from the GDT e-Tax portal, after business registration.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Worldwide income taxed 0–20%, plus a 1% minimum tax on turnover.
facts.L4_vat_gst: 10% VAT above KHR 60m in three months for services; exports zero-rated.
facts.L5_data_protection: No data protection law yet; a draft was released in July 2025.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: E-commerce and consumer laws exist; no cooling-off right was found.

watch_out.text: There's a 1% minimum tax on turnover, even without profit.
